`CircuitStateController.EnsureNotDisposed` (line 278) is reached by 8 methods from the devkb graph, plus 2 more that reach it only through delegates. I found those two with grep, and the graph missed them. I modified no files.

**Direct callers** (each calls `EnsureNotDisposed()` itself):
- `CircuitStateController.CircuitState` (line 53)
- `CircuitStateController.LastException` (line 66)
- `CircuitStateController.LastHandledOutcome` (line 79)
- `CircuitStateController.IsolateCircuitAsync` (line 90)
- `CircuitStateController.CloseCircuitAsync` (line 110)
- `CircuitStateController.OnActionPreExecuteAsync` (line 126)
- `CircuitStateController.OnUnhandledOutcomeAsync` (line 196)
- `CircuitStateController.OnHandledOutcomeAsync` (line 222)

**Indirect callers:**
- `CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategy.ExecuteCore` calls `OnActionPreExecuteAsync` (line 32). It also calls `OnHandledOutcomeAsync` and `OnUnhandledOutcomeAsync` (lines 52 and 56).
- The `CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategy` constructor hands `_controller.CircuitState`, `IsolateCircuitAsync` and `CloseCircuitAsync` to other types as delegates (lines 18–21):
  - `CircuitBreakerStateProvider.CircuitState` invokes the `CircuitState` delegate (line 32).
  - `CircuitBreakerManualControl.IsolateAsync` and `CircuitBreakerManualControl.CloseAsync` invoke the isolate and close callbacks.
  - I did not read the bodies of `IsolateAsync` and `CloseAsync` past the delegate fields, so that link is inferred from how they are wired.

The legacy `Polly` package has its own separate `CircuitStateController` (`src/Polly/CircuitBreaker/CircuitStateController.cs`). It is a different type and does not reach this method.

**Test files:**
- `test/Polly.Core.Tests/CircuitBreaker/Controller/CircuitStateControllerTests.cs` is the one the graph named. For example, line 167 asserts `ObjectDisposedException` from `IsolateCircuitAsync`.
- These four files reference the controller or the delegate wrappers, so they exercise it indirectly. I found them by searching for the type and method names and did not open them:
  - `test/Polly.Core.Tests/CircuitBreaker/CircuitBreakerResilienceStrategyTests.cs`
  - `test/Polly.Core.Tests/CircuitBreaker/CircuitBreakerManualControlTests.cs`
  - `test/Polly.Core.Tests/CircuitBreaker/CircuitBreakerStateProviderTests.cs`
  - `test/Polly.Core.Tests/CircuitBreaker/CircuitBreakerResiliencePipelineBuilderTests.cs`

The graph flagged 9 call sites it could not attribute, because 40 symbols share the name `EnsureNotDisposed`. The files it listed are pipeline components such as `CompositeComponent`, `DelegatingComponent` and `BridgeComponent`. None of them involve the circuit breaker controller, so I left them out.
